content.short: Sunrise is a Layer 1 blockchain delivering Data Availability with Proof of Liquidity and fee abstraction.
content.description: Sunrise is a Layer 1 blockchain focused on Data Availability, using Proof of Liquidity to govern consensus and enable fee abstraction. Designed for L2 developers, Sunrise unlocks big-block capabilities with off-chain Blobs, expanding scalability for data-intensive applications such as on-chain AI, decentralized gaming, and other demanding workloads. Data Availability fee abstraction is achieved by supplying liquidity in Sunrise’s native DEX, allowing users to manage costs more predictably. The protocol pursues sustainable economics and broad developer accessibility.
